title: Concept: Subscription plan and seat detail exposed
description: A plan name with a seat count and a renewal date in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The detail is commercial information about the bank's contract, and it also tells an attacker which premium features the tenant can reach.
applicability: Deployments that render a plan name with a seat count and a renewal date into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The detail is commercial information about the bank's contract, and it also tells an attacker which premium features the tenant can reach.
